name: zhishu-workspace
description: 独立多项目 智枢，规划以场景插件组合规则、Skills 与跨 IDE 能力

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @zhishu/core && npm run build --workspace @zhishu/adapter-codex && npm run build --workspace zhishu
scripts.check: npm run check:rulepacks && npm run check:plugins && npm run check:consistency && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && node --test scripts/tests/cli-e2e.test.mjs scripts/tests/remote-cli-e2e.test.mjs scripts/tests/package-install.test.mjs scripts/tests/rulepacks-validation.test.mjs scripts/tests/consistency-validation.test.mjs scripts/tests/release-manifest.test.mjs scripts/tests/publication-gates.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @zhishu/core && npm run build --workspace @zhishu/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @zhishu/adapter-codex && npm run build --workspace @zhishu/adapter-codex && npm run typecheck --workspace zhishu
